name: Glycopyrronium Bromide

examples.title: ANTES B+ Clinical Trial
examples.why: Delays in the opening and activation of participating sites, and a low recruitment rate, with only 48 participants enrolled over the course of one year

examples.title: Effect of Atropine or Glycopyrrolate on the Prevention of Bradycardia During Sedation Using Dexmedetomidine in Adult Patients Undergoing…
examples.why: The research was terminated because the recruitment of the study subjects was not smooth and the overseas training of the investigator was scheduled.

examples.title: Use of Dexmedetomidine in Acute Stroke and Cerebral Vasospasm Interventions
examples.why: The principal investigator left employment at the sponsoring Institution

summary: A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low risk scores of 19 for the liver and 37 for the heart for Glycopyrronium Bromide [M]. Multiple clinical trials involving this medication were stopped early due to non-medical issues, such as slow participant recruitment, site activation delays, and researcher departures [4][5][6]. Specific studies ended because only 48 people joined over a year, an investigator had scheduled overseas training, or a lead researcher left their institution [4][5][6].
